items.markdown:
Alcohol (ethanol) is primarily metabolized in the **liver** , which breaks down about 90% or more of the alcohol you consume.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXwaSyGt5OdF19gk2v6Xv6g75x1-7vS2m4CeDOJdp5n1_tOvVXVfNbW0_b2Oha-Tw6rZ7mtAH7jm5RcgJziwsSh2uXwSadQMq4eu7XBGMNQf7NhVy9KUr2gTLO4iyewvEpblgEbRGa8t3oV02DzK271U8)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXX1mycUlgMHo6Dy-SAbQQRXjpsNd0NTLgdf8cdaNq2S2OaMtc6j22WT9H7_xcdDe7pFPaPe-XC5ynWAAcqe1KrJEUWcbhPI_dcMsBWUuV5PSzkM3qrxmuyWPwoIgUixCLsbRq80aiwHB9AYrfpaQ)

### How Liver Metabolism Works

- **Step 1 (Alcohol to Acetaldehyde):** Enzymes—mainly **alcohol dehydrogenase (ADH)** , along with **CYP2E1** and catalase—convert ethanol into **acetaldehyde** , a toxic compound.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXxvjvqQreq_n-QJ8iUc8q-OmLnY_Yj2JgPdWoX3Z7L-WoyB7AoinDzeJEiSD0g7cekBSK8oGwh_YnuEKGkkXN_mxuLfpEX71cuYOpik71zfKBpdw1gQx_tAZrp6B7bmhSjVDlOLkf_qEn)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXwaSyGt5OdF19gk2v6Xv6g75x1-7vS2m4CeDOJdp5n1_tOvVXVfNbW0_b2Oha-Tw6rZ7mtAH7jm5RcgJziwsSh2uXwSadQMq4eu7XBGMNQf7NhVy9KUr2gTLO4iyewvEpblgEbRGa8t3oV02DzK271U8)
- **Step 2 (Acetaldehyde to Acetate):** **Aldehyde dehydrogenase (ALDH)** quickly breaks acetaldehyde down into **acetate** , a less harmful substance.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXX1mycUlgMHo6Dy-SAbQQRXjpsNd0NTLgdf8cdaNq2S2OaMtc6j22WT9H7_xcdDe7pFPaPe-XC5ynWAAcqe1KrJEUWcbhPI_dcMsBWUuV5PSzkM3qrxmuyWPwoIgUixCLsbRq80aiwHB9AYrfpaQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXwaSyGt5OdF19gk2v6Xv6g75x1-7vS2m4CeDOJdp5n1_tOvVXVfNbW0_b2Oha-Tw6rZ7mtAH7jm5RcgJziwsSh2uXwSadQMq4eu7XBGMNQf7NhVy9KUr2gTLO4iyewvEpblgEbRGa8t3oV02DzK271U8)
- **Final Breakdown:** Acetate is mostly released into the bloodstream and broken down into carbon dioxide and water in other tissues.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF1-0Tdu3CIEohjQV_7YPbRp7ZygaAO0zR5MXJxq5KbipEyjU8rW_UIJJWuhOaFdZs8nz_RTqkjcSKH8iWae1jasqA9qcXEXObYrl-uQHFF69qAXP2rbap19uoecgcw4UlKqnsvJaNHdafY8IRjbUXLSS84Ek3nYXndFTbeg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXwaSyGt5OdF19gk2v6Xv6g75x1-7vS2m4CeDOJdp5n1_tOvVXVfNbW0_b2Oha-Tw6rZ7mtAH7jm5RcgJziwsSh2uXwSadQMq4eu7XBGMNQf7NhVy9KUr2gTLO4iyewvEpblgEbRGa8t3oV02DzK271U8)

### Other Sites and Elimination

- **Gastrointestinal Tract:** Small amounts of alcohol are broken down in the stomach and digestive tract before reaching the liver.
- **Other Tissues:** Minor metabolism can occur in tissues like the brain and pancreas.
- **Unchanged Excretion:** Roughly 5% to 10% of alcohol leaves the body unchanged through breath, urine, and sweat.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnQEBxCJF10IXUS6kwC10RLi31hd9LkNJKC12WTtWiDSZQwc_UDLYfhYYo36z_LPU3ejNRIsI8j06-s0rg_T2y94FZoENOiQsIKL2z2ETgGnOt0xLaV7U5dNno4Zsl5ZqFyV2VDXhTmpArmTXjCDEFDkQsKWzbgLbd3uUAm4-kQp8qmbJCQ9XZ_mW7hrmvAprexupspLQu7RGuNeFxCbr)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXwaSyGt5OdF19gk2v6Xv6g75x1-7vS2m4CeDOJdp5n1_tOvVXVfNbW0_b2Oha-Tw6rZ7mtAH7jm5RcgJziwsSh2uXwSadQMq4eu7XBGMNQf7NhVy9KUr2gTLO4iyewvEpblgEbRGa8t3oV02DzK271U8)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXEdG2KQljGUXmKWLtZ9y3Welg3bEg620O-7kvNoQG2PRdZ2AxxCivRFMluPrgwJgkwMER07YDs20xZj_uGFfczaCe5XSfWlTO9VCsdQOBxh8lVNtiTBGIHG4erWsLYe0oGyx0)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXX1mycUlgMHo6Dy-SAbQQRXjpsNd0NTLgdf8cdaNq2S2OaMtc6j22WT9H7_xcdDe7pFPaPe-XC5ynWAAcqe1KrJEUWcbhPI_dcMsBWUuV5PSzkM3qrxmuyWPwoIgUixCLsbRq80aiwHB9AYrfpaQ)
